title: 2006 AMC 10A Problem 17
statement: In rectangle \(ADEH,\) points \(B\) and \(C\) trisect \(\overline{AD},\) and points \(G\) and \(F\) trisect \(\overline{HE}.\) In addition, \(AH = AC = 2.\) What is the area of quadrilateral \(WXYZ\) shown in the figure?

solutions.text:
Set \(A = (0, 0),\) \(D = (3, 0),\) \(H = (0, 2),\) so \(B = (1, 0),\) \(C = (2, 0),\) \(G = (1, 2),\) \(F = (2, 2),\) and \(E = (3, 2).\)

The drawn segments meet at \(W = (1.5, 1.5),\) \(X = (1, 1),\) \(Y = (1.5, 0.5),\) and \(Z = (2, 1).\) These form a square whose perpendicular diagonals \(WY\) and \(XZ\) each have length \(1.\)

Its area is \(\frac12 \cdot 1 \cdot 1 = \frac12.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Assign coordinates using \(AB = BC = CD = 1\) and \(AH = 2\)
\(WXYZ\) is a square; find its diagonals
